sections.heading: 1. Kernel Overview
sections.gist: table columns: Kernel, Build Function, Data Types, Key Features

sections.heading: 2. Normalization Kernel
sections.gist: Computes `LayerNorm(x) = (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps) * gamma + beta`.

sections.heading: 3. Softmax Kernel
sections.gist: Row-wise softmax: `softmax(x)_i = exp(x_i - max(x)) / sum(exp(x - max(x)))`.

sections.heading: 4. GEMM Kernel
sections.gist: MFMA 16×16 GEMM with B matrix pre-shuffled: `C[M,N] = A[M,K] @ B[N,K]^T`.

sections.heading: 5. MoE Kernel
sections.gist: Two-stage MoE: Stage 1 (Gate GEMM + SiLU activation + Up GEMM), Stage 2 (Down GEMM + reduction).

sections.heading: 7. MFMA Instruction Reference
sections.gist: table columns: Instruction, Data Type, M×N×K, Architecture

sections.heading: 8. Instruction Scheduling Control
sections.gist: Used arg0 manual control of instruction scheduling, ensuring overlap of computation and data movement.
